compare 2021 with 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda, percentage-point change in ANC4 completed divided by registered

```sql
SELECT
    district,
    100.0 * (anc4_2023 / NULLIF(registered_2023, 0)) -
    100.0 * (anc4_2021 / NULLIF(registered_2021, 0)) AS pct_point_change
FROM (
    SELECT
        district,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed END) AS anc4_2023,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered END) AS registered_2023,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc4_completed END) AS anc4_2021,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pregnancies_registered END) AS registered_2021
    FROM anc_visits
    WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
      AND year IN (2021, 2023)
    GROUP BY district
) AS t;
```
